title: Appending a Choice Bit to a Window-Bounded Run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ and $w$ be binary strings, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a bit. If every configuration reached along every prefix of $w$ lies in the window of radius $s$, and the configuration reached after the choice string $wb$ also lies in that window, then every configuration reached along every prefix of $wb$ lies in the window of radius $s$.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet.
x and w are binary strings.
For every prefix length j from 0 through |w|, the configuration after the first j choice bits of w lies in the radius-s window.
The configuration reached after the choice string wb lies in the radius-s window.
